limitations: D-002: the iodine K-edge (33.17 keV) is under-resolved on the 1 keV table. Data generation and estimation use the SAME table, a shared-model limitation. No absolute iodine-concentration accuracy claim is made; only identifiability, conditioning and noise claims.
k=2 Jacobian/CRLB for P3 are evaluated at the truncated A[:, :2]; CRLB is not valid for misspecified cells and emp/CRLB is not claimed there.
mismatch_definition: tilt: phi*(1 + t(E-Ebar)/Ebar), t=+-0.1; energy scale: phi(E/(1+s)), s=+-0.02; windows/responses stay nominal; estimator always uses nominal spectra

a.criterion: M1, k>=2: every sampled ray has rank 1 (<k)

b.criterion: M2 k=2: rank 2 on every ray, finite cond

c.criterion: M2 k=3: rank<=2<3 on every ray => non-identifiable

d.criterion: M4 k=3 identifiable (all rays) and iodine CRLB std (median over iodine rays) larger than M2 k=2 at equal N_tot (P3, N=1e6)

e.criterion: P3 data, k=2 estimator: iodine-A per-ray rms bias > 3x its noise floor at both N_tot and bias(1e6)/bias(1e5) > 0.5 (a 1/sqrt(N) bias would give 0.32)

f.criterion: same bias test as (e) for each matched-k cell x mismatch condition

g.criterion: median emp/CRLB per material within 25% (success) at N=1e6, matched cells; >50% = STOP

scaling: For every design and data condition the fluence (SpekPy native normalisation, absolute scale UNVERIFIED) is rescaled so that sum over rows b and energies e of R[b,e]*Phi[e] (unattenuated expected counts, all rows summed) equals N_tot; exposures of M2 share N_tot/2 each. Asserted to 1e-9 relative for every cell. M4 counts only photons inside 20-120 keV. Tilt/energy-scale mismatch is applied to the data fluence BEFORE rescaling, so mismatch cells also have exactly N_tot photons.

scope.full_image: single noise realisation, all 90x72 rays, for cells in full_image records only (N_tot in both levels; matched and tilt+10% data); rho via unconstrained dense LS of A_hat
scope.per_ray_subset: Fisher/CRLB/rank/empirical std/bias on a fixed subset of rays (48 rays P2, 60 rays P3: 6 rays through each insert centre + 30 random rays), 20 Poisson realisations each. NOT full image.
scope.stats_exclude_nonconverged: non-converged fits are excluded from bias/std but their fraction is reported (lm_fail_frac) per cell

weighting.M1_M2: energy-integrating: R[b,e] = E_e / Ebar (Ebar = photon-mean energy of the nominal exposure), i.e. proportional to E, normalised so unattenuated lambda = photon count; Poisson noise is applied to this normalised count (an idealisation)
weighting.M4: photon counting: R[b,e] = indicator(window), weight 1 per photon; windows [20,50),[50,70),[70,90),[90,120] keV
